owner_tin_check.name: owner_tin_check
owner_tin_check.value: ("owner"."tin_encrypted" is null) = ("owner"."tin_index" is null) and ("owner"."tin_encrypted" is null) = ("owner"."tin_masked" is null)

lease_break_check.name: lease_break_check
lease_break_check.value: ("lease"."break_from_date" is null) = ("lease"."break_party" is null) and ("lease"."break_from_date" is null) = ("lease"."break_notice_days" is null) and ("lease"."break_from_date" is null) = ("lease"."break_credit_unused_days" is null) and ("lease"."break_party" is null or "lease"."break_party" in ('tenant', 'landlord', 'either'))

lease_template_version_review_check.name: lease_template_version_review_check
lease_template_version_review_check.value: ("lease_template_version"."counsel_reviewed_at" is null) = ("lease_template_version"."counsel_reviewed_by" is null) and ("lease_template_version"."counsel_reviewed_at" is null) = ("lease_template_version"."counsel_review_note" is null)

tenant_id_number_check.name: tenant_id_number_check
tenant_id_number_check.value: ("tenant"."id_type" is null) = ("tenant"."id_number_encrypted" is null) and ("tenant"."id_number_encrypted" is null) = ("tenant"."id_number_index" is null) and ("tenant"."id_number_encrypted" is null) = ("tenant"."id_number_masked" is null)

tenant_tin_check.name: tenant_tin_check
tenant_tin_check.value: ("tenant"."tin_encrypted" is null) = ("tenant"."tin_index" is null) and ("tenant"."tin_encrypted" is null) = ("tenant"."tin_masked" is null) and ("tenant"."tin_encrypted" is null or "tenant"."kind" = 'company')

tenant_company_fields_check.name: tenant_company_fields_check
tenant_company_fields_check.value: "tenant"."kind" = 'company' or ("tenant"."registration_number" is null and "tenant"."business_type" is null and "tenant"."legal_name" is null)

secure_link_signer_check.name: secure_link_signer_check
secure_link_signer_check.value: "secure_link"."purpose" not in ('sign', 'signed_copy') or "secure_link"."signer_id" is not null

signature_method_fields_check.name: signature_method_fields_check
signature_method_fields_check.value: ("signature"."method" = 'typed' and "signature"."typed_name" is not null) or ("signature"."method" = 'drawn' and "signature"."drawing_document_id" is not null)

signer_subject_check.name: signer_subject_check
signer_subject_check.value: "signer"."subject_type" in ('tenant', 'tenant_contact', 'staff', 'other') and ("signer"."subject_type" <> 'tenant_contact' or "signer"."tenant_contact_id" is not null) and ("signer"."subject_type" <> 'staff' or "signer"."staff_person_id" is not null) and ("signer"."subject_type" <> 'tenant' or "signer"."tenant_id" is not null)

signer_contact_check.name: signer_contact_check
signer_contact_check.value: "signer"."phone" is not null or "signer"."email" is not null

signing_request_lease_check.name: signing_request_lease_check
signing_request_lease_check.value: "signing_request"."subject_type" <> 'lease' or ("signing_request"."lease_id" is not null and "signing_request"."tenant_id" is not null)

signing_request_document_check.name: signing_request_document_check
signing_request_document_check.value: "signing_request"."status" in ('preparing', 'cancelled') or ("signing_request"."document_id" is not null and "signing_request"."document_sha256" is not null)

signing_request_final_check.name: signing_request_final_check
signing_request_final_check.value: "signing_request"."status" <> 'completed' or ("signing_request"."final_document_id" is not null and "signing_request"."final_sha256" is not null and "signing_request"."completed_at" is not null)

message_recipient_check.name: message_recipient_check
message_recipient_check.value: "message"."recipient_type" in ('tenant', 'tenant_contact', 'staff', 'signer') and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'tenant' or "message"."tenant_id" is not null) and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'tenant_contact' or "message"."tenant_contact_id" is not null) and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'staff' or "message"."staff_person_id" is not null) and ("message"."recipient_type" <> 'signer' or "message"."signer_id" is not null)

message_link_check.name: message_link_check
message_link_check.value: ("message"."link_purpose" is null or "message"."link_purpose" in ('sign', 'signed_copy', 'id_capture')) and ("message"."link_purpose" is null) = ("message"."link_target_id" is null)

message_event_sent_check.name: message_event_sent_check
message_event_sent_check.value: "message_event"."status" <> 'sent' or ("message_event"."channel" is not null and "message_event"."provider" is not null and "message_event"."provider_message_id" is not null)

message_event_cost_check.name: message_event_cost_check
message_event_cost_check.value: ("message_event"."cost_minor" is null) = ("message_event"."currency" is null) and ("message_event"."cost_minor" is null or "message_event"."cost_minor" >= 0)
